item.title: Students making protest signs kicked out of Harris Learning Library for not booking room
item.description: Students making protest signs over OSAP cuts were told to leave the library because they didn't book the space beforehand.

item.title: $14 million in asbestos cleanup needed in social housing units
item.description: Nipissing District Housing Corporation units built in 70s and 80s don't need to be cleaned of asbestos until they are retired.

item.title: North Bay Battalion punch playoff ticket with Brampton Steelheads loss
item.description: Battalion clinch a playoff spot from their couches after Brampton lost to the Brantford Bulldogs on Wednesday night

item.title: Traffic enforcement initiative results in four vehicles being removed from road
item.description: The goal of the latest Commercial Motor Vehicle Enforcement Initiative is to enhance road safety and preventing serious collisions

item.title: Ecole Secondaire Algonquin gets ready for the OFSAA Girls' A Championship
item.description: The OFSAA 'A' Volleyball Championships are coming to North Bay at Ecole Secondaire Algonquin over the second weekend in March

item.title: Nipissing Lakers men's volleyball team has a date with destiny Friday night
item.description: A confident bunch of Nipissing Lakers men's volleyball players head to the OUA semifinals in Kingston Friday night

item.title: Cassellholme board chair Mendicino still wants King and Mayne off the board
item.description: Cassellholme board chair Dave Mendicino describes criticisms of the board by three sitting North Bay City councillors as "without merit"

item.title: North Bay Battalion eke out 4-3 win over gritty Kingston Frontenacs on Thursday night
item.description: The Battalion found a way to win Thursday despite a major effort by the Kingston Frontenacs and gained a point on Peterborough who lost to Windsor in a shootout
